   200	    |∑ a, (inner ℂ (u a) (applyOperatorToState (A a) (v a))).re|
   201	        ≤ ∑ a, |(inner ℂ (u a) (applyOperatorToState (A a) (v a))).re| :=
   202	      Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _
   203	    _ ≤ ∑ a, Real.sqrt (inner ℂ (u a) (applyOperatorToState (A a) (u a))).re *
   204	          Real.sqrt (inner ℂ (v a) (applyOperatorToState (A a) (v a))).re := by
   205	      refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun a _ => ?_
   206	      exact (Complex.abs_re_le_norm _).trans
   207	        (norm_inner_applyOperatorToState_le_sqrt_mul_sqrt (hA a) (u a) (v a))
   208	    _ ≤ Real.sqrt (∑ a,
   209	            Real.sqrt (inner ℂ (u a) (applyOperatorToState (A a) (u a))).re ^ 2) *
   210	          Real.sqrt (∑ a,
   211	            Real.sqrt (inner ℂ (v a) (applyOperatorToState (A a) (v a))).re ^ 2) :=
   212	      Real.sum_mul_le_sqrt_mul_sqrt _ _ _
   213	    _ = _ := by
   214	      rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => Real.sq_sqrt (hu a),
   215	        Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => Real.sq_sqrt (hv a)]

   220	theorem abs_avgOver_sum_re_inner_le_sqrt_mul_sqrt {X α ι : Type*} [Fintype α]

   271	/-- The real quadratic form is invariant under the conjugate transpose. -/
   272	theorem stateQForm_conjTranspose {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
   273	    (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) (M : Op ι) :
   274	    stateQForm ψ Mᴴ = stateQForm ψ M := by
   275	  unfold stateQForm
   276	  change (inner ℂ ψ (Matrix.toEuclideanLin Mᴴ ψ)).re =
   277	    (inner ℂ ψ (Matrix.toEuclideanLin M ψ)).re
   278	  rw [Matrix.toEuclideanLin_conjTranspose_eq_adjoint, LinearMap.adjoint_inner_right,
   279	    ← inner_conj_symm, Complex.conj_re]

   281	/-- Conjugating an operator transfers the outer operator to the state vector. -/
   282	theorem stateQForm_conjTranspose_mul_mul {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
   283	    (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) (W M : Op ι) :
   284	    stateQForm ψ (Wᴴ * M * W) = stateQForm (applyOperatorToState W ψ) M := by
   285	  unfold stateQForm
   286	  rw [applyOperatorToState_mul, applyOperatorToState_mul]
   287	  congr 1
   288	  change inner ℂ ψ (Matrix.toEuclideanLin Wᴴ _) =
   289	    inner ℂ (Matrix.toEuclideanLin W ψ) _
   290	  rw [Matrix.toEuclideanLin_conjTranspose_eq_adjoint, LinearMap.adjoint_inner_right]

   311	theorem sum_stateQForm_effect_eq_one {α ι : Type*} [Fintype α] [Fintype ι]

   314	    (∑ a : α, stateQForm ψ (A.effect a)) = 1 := by

   322	/-- Weighting a complete measurement by commuting projections cannot exceed

   324	theorem avgOver_sum_stateQForm_mul_le_one {X α ι : Type*} [Fintype α]

    27	/-- A positive atom gives a positive atom of every push-forward. -/
    28	private theorem map_weight_pos_of_weight_pos {Source Target : Type*}
    29	    [DecidableEq Target] (law : Distribution Source) (mapping : Source → Target)
    30	    (sample : Source) (hpositive : 0 < law.weight sample) :
    31	    0 < (law.map mapping).weight (mapping sample) := by
    32	  classical
    33	  have hmem : sample ∈ law.support := by
    34	    by_contra hnot
    35	    simp [law.outsideSupport sample hnot] at hpositive
    36	  exact hpositive.trans_le (Finset.single_le_sum
    37	    (fun other _ => law.nonnegative other) (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hmem, rfl⟩))

    39	/-- Every canonical direct line has positive marginal mass. In particular, the
    40	conditional distribution in the construction at paper lines 1118--1132 is defined
    41	on every direct line, including zero-direction diagonal lines. -/
    42	theorem directLinePointDist_line_weight_pos (params : DirectLdParams)
    43	    (line : DirectLineDesc params) :
    44	    0 < ((directLinePointDist params).map Prod.fst).weight line := by
    45	  have huniform (sample : DirectLdSpace params) :
    46	      0 < (uniformDistribution (DirectLdSpace params)).weight sample := by
    47	    rw [uniformDistribution_weight_apply]
    48	    positivity
    49	  suffices hpoint : 0 < (directLinePointDist params).weight (line, line.base) by
    50	    exact map_weight_pos_of_weight_pos _ Prod.fst _ hpoint
    51	  cases line with
    52	  | axis base index baseFixed =>
    53	    let sample : DirectLdSpace params := ⟨base, index, 0⟩
    54	    have haxis := map_weight_pos_of_weight_pos
    55	      (uniformDistribution (DirectLdSpace params))
    56	      (fun source => (directALineDescOf params source, source.point)) sample (huniform sample)
    57	    have hdecode : directALineDescOf params sample = .axis base index baseFixed := by
    58	      simp [directALineDescOf, sample, baseFixed]
    59	    change 0 < (directALinePointDist params).weight _ at haxis
    60	    rw [hdecode] at haxis
    61	    have hother := (directDLinePointDist params).nonnegative
    62	      (DirectLineDesc.axis base index baseFixed, base)
    63	    change 0 < (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (directALinePointDist params).weight _ +
    64	      (1 - 1 / 2) * (directDLinePointDist params).weight _
    65	    change 0 < (directALinePointDist params).weight
    66	      (DirectLineDesc.axis base index baseFixed, base) at haxis
    67	    dsimp only [DirectLineDesc.base]
    68	    linarith
    69	  | diagonal base index direction baseFixed prefixZero =>
    70	    let sample : DirectLdSpace params := ⟨base, index, direction⟩
    71	    have hprefix : directPrefixProjection index direction = direction := by
    72	      funext coordinate
    73	      simp only [directPrefixProjection]
    74	      split_ifs with hbefore
    75	      · exact (prefixZero coordinate hbefore).symm
    76	      · rfl
    77	    have hdiagonal := map_weight_pos_of_weight_pos
    78	      (uniformDistribution (DirectLdSpace params))
    79	      (fun source => (directDLineDescOf params source, source.point)) sample (huniform sample)
    80	    have hdecode : directDLineDescOf params sample =
    81	        .diagonal base index direction baseFixed prefixZero := by
    82	      simp [directDLineDescOf, sample, hprefix, baseFixed]
    83	    change 0 < (directDLinePointDist params).weight _ at hdiagonal
    84	    rw [hdecode] at hdiagonal
    85	    have hother := (directALinePointDist params).nonnegative
    86	      (DirectLineDesc.diagonal base index direction baseFixed prefixZero, base)
    87	    change 0 < (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (directALinePointDist params).weight _ +
    88	      (1 - 1 / 2) * (directDLinePointDist params).weight _
    89	    change 0 < (directDLinePointDist params).weight
    90	      (DirectLineDesc.diagonal base index direction baseFixed prefixZero, base) at hdiagonal
    91	    dsimp only [DirectLineDesc.base]
    92	    linarith

   107	/-- The genuine conditional law of the supported subline triples given their
   108	extended line, as in paper lines 1118--1132. Every extended line has positive
   109	marginal mass. -/

   113	  support := Finset.univ

   172	/-- The directly indexed form of the extended-line POVM at paper lines
   173	1118--1132: condition the subline law and average the postprocessed paired-line POVMs. -/
   174	def SubLineWitness.extendedMeasurement {params : AdmissibleParams}
   175	    {error pointError lineError : ℝ} {setting : ProjectiveSetting params error}
   176	    {points : CombinedPointsWitness setting pointError}
   177	    (sublines : SubLineWitness params) (lines : CombinedLinesWitness setting points lineError)
   178	    (side : PlayerSide) (line : DirectLineDesc params.extendedDirectLd) :
   179	    Quantum.Measurement (DirectDegPoly params.extendedDirectLd (params.m * params.d + 1))
   180	      (setting.ExpandedLocalSpace side) := by
   181	  let family (sample : sublines.Fiber line) :=
   182	    (lines.T side sample.val.2.1 sample.val.2.2).postprocess
   183	      (sublines.combinedPolynomial sample.val (Finset.mem_filter.mp sample.property).1)
   184	  have hsum : (∑ polynomial, averageOperatorOverDistribution (sublines.conditionalLaw line)
   185	      (fun sample => (family sample).effect polynomial)) = 1 := by
   186	    rw [← averageOperatorOverDistribution_sum]
   187	    simp only [Quantum.Measurement.sum_eq_one]
   188	    exact averageOperatorOverDistribution_const_of_isProbability _
   189	      (sublines.conditionalLaw_isProbability line) 1
   190	  exact { effect := fun polynomial => averageOperatorOverDistribution
   191	            (sublines.conditionalLaw line) (fun sample => (family sample).effect polynomial)
   192	          pos := fun polynomial => averageOperatorOverDistribution_nonneg _ _
   193	            (fun sample => (family sample).pos polynomial)
   194	          sum_le_one := le_of_eq hsum
   195	          sum_eq_one := hsum }

   197	/-- Integrating the conditional law recovers the original subline law.
   198	This is finite disintegration, not an independence assertion about projections. -/
   199	theorem SubLineWitness.avgOver_conditionalLaw {params : AdmissibleParams}
   200	    (sublines : SubLineWitness params) (quantity : SubLineTriple params → ℝ) :
   201	    avgOver (sublines.D.map Prod.fst) (fun line =>
   202	      avgOver (sublines.conditionalLaw line) (fun sample => quantity sample.val)) =
   203	        avgOver sublines.D quantity := by
   204	  classical
   205	  simp only [avgOver, SubLineWitness.conditionalLaw]
   206	  calc
   207	    (∑ line ∈ (sublines.D.map Prod.fst).support,
   208	        (sublines.D.map Prod.fst).weight line *
   209	          ∑ sample : sublines.Fiber line,
   210	            (sublines.D.weight sample.val / (sublines.D.map Prod.fst).weight line) *
   211	              quantity sample.val) =
   212	        ∑ line ∈ (sublines.D.map Prod.fst).support,
   213	          ∑ sample ∈ sublines.D.support.filter (fun sample => sample.1 = line),
   214	            sublines.D.weight sample * quantity sample := by
   215	      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   216	      intro line _
   217	      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
   218	      trans ∑ sample : sublines.Fiber line, sublines.D.weight sample.val * quantity sample.val
   219	      · apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   220	        intro sample _
   221	        field_simp [(sublines.fiber_mass_pos line).ne']
   222	        exact (div_eq_iff (sublines.fiber_mass_pos line).ne').mpr (by ring)
   223	      · exact Finset.sum_coe_sort
   224	          (sublines.D.support.filter (fun sample => sample.1 = line))
   225	          (fun sample => sublines.D.weight sample * quantity sample)
   226	    _ = ∑ sample ∈ sublines.D.support, sublines.D.weight sample * quantity sample := by
   227	      exact Finset.sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to
   228	        (fun sample hsample => Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨sample, hsample, rfl⟩) _

   244	private theorem evalCoefficient_extendedScalar {params : AdmissibleParams} {bound : ℕ}
   245	    (polynomial : DirectDegPoly params.extendedDirectLd bound)
   246	    (parameter : DirectScalarQ params.extendedDirectLd) :

   252	/-- If both projected polynomials have determined values, their actual combined

   254	covers zero-direction lines: every parameter is checked, rather than selecting

   256	theorem SubLineWitness.combinedPolynomial_evaluatesTo {params : AdmissibleParams}
   257	    (sublines : SubLineWitness params) (sample : SubLineTriple params)
   258	    (hsample : sample ∈ sublines.D.support)
   259	    (polynomials : DegPoly params.toLdParams (params.m * params.d) ×
   260	      DegPoly params.toLdParams (params.m * params.d))
   261	    (point : Fin params.extendedDirectLd.m → DirectScalarQ params.extendedDirectLd)
   262	    (hpoint : point ∈ sample.1.pointSet) (valueX valueZ : PauliScalar params)
   263	    (hevalX : EvaluatesTo sample.2.1 polynomials.1
   264	      (projX (directPointToPauli params point)) valueX)
   265	    (hevalZ : EvaluatesTo sample.2.2 polynomials.2
   266	      (projZ (directPointToPauli params point)) valueZ) :
   267	    DirectEvaluatesTo sample.1 (sublines.combinedPolynomial sample hsample polynomials) point
   268	      ((extendedDirectScalarEquiv params).symm
   269	        ((directPointToPauli params point) (alphaVar params.m) * valueX +
   270	          (directPointToPauli params point) (betaVar params.m) * valueZ)) := by
   271	  obtain ⟨initialParameter, hinitial⟩ := hpoint
   272	  refine ⟨⟨initialParameter, hinitial⟩, ?_⟩
   273	  intro parameter hparameter
   274	  let data := sublines.affineData sample hsample
   275	  have hcompat := sublines.affineData_compatible sample hsample
   276	  have hformula := combineLinePoly_spec
   277	    (directPointToPauli params sample.1.base) (directPointToPauli params sample.1.direction)
   278	    sample.2.1.base sample.2.1.direction sample.2.2.base sample.2.2.direction

   319	/-- Coefficient support bounds the degree of the represented polynomial. -/
   320	private theorem linePolynomial_natDegree_le_of_coefficients {Scalar : Type*}
   321	    [Field Scalar] {bound degree : ℕ} (polynomial : Fin (bound + 1) → Scalar)
   322	    (hdegree : ∀ index, degree < index.val → polynomial index = 0) :
   323	    (linePolynomialOfCoefficients polynomial).natDegree ≤ degree := by
   324	  apply Polynomial.natDegree_sum_le_of_forall_le
   325	  intro index _
   326	  by_cases hindex : index.val ≤ degree
   327	  · refine Polynomial.natDegree_mul_le.trans ?_
   328	    have hpower := Polynomial.natDegree_pow_le
   329	      (p := (Polynomial.X : Polynomial Scalar)) (n := index.val)
   330	    simp only [Polynomial.natDegree_X, Nat.mul_one] at hpower
   331	    simpa using hpower.trans hindex
   332	  · simp [hdegree index (Nat.lt_of_not_ge hindex)]

   334	/-- Affine substitution preserves a degree bound. -/
   335	private theorem affine_comp_natDegree_le {Scalar : Type*} [Field Scalar]
   336	    (polynomial : Polynomial Scalar) (offset slope : Scalar) {degree : ℕ}
   337	    (hdegree : polynomial.natDegree ≤ degree) :
   338	    (polynomial.comp (Polynomial.C offset + Polynomial.C slope * Polynomial.X)).natDegree ≤
   339	      degree := by
   340	  have haffine : (Polynomial.C offset + Polynomial.C slope * Polynomial.X).natDegree ≤ 1 := by
   341	    refine (Polynomial.natDegree_add_le _ _).trans (max_le ?_ ?_)
   342	    · simp
   343	    · exact Polynomial.natDegree_mul_le.trans (by simp)
   344	  exact Polynomial.natDegree_comp_le.trans (by simpa using Nat.mul_le_mul hdegree haffine)

   346	/-- The source combination has degree at most `degree` on an axis line:
   347	either the two scalar coordinates are constant, or both projected parameters
   348	are constant. This is the algebraic assertion at paper lines 1127--1132. -/
   349	theorem combineLinePoly_axis_degree {Scalar : Type*} [Field Scalar] {bound degree : ℕ}
   350	    (hdegree : 1 ≤ degree) (data : Fin 8 → Scalar)
   351	    (polynomialX polynomialZ : Fin (bound + 1) → Scalar)
   352	    (hdegreeX : ∀ index, degree < index.val → polynomialX index = 0)
   353	    (hdegreeZ : ∀ index, degree < index.val → polynomialZ index = 0)
   354	    (haxis : (data 5 = 0 ∧ data 7 = 0) ∨ (data 1 = 0 ∧ data 3 = 0)) :
   355	    ∀ index : Fin (bound + 1 + 1), degree < index.val →
   356	      combineLinePoly (data 0) (data 1) (data 2) (data 3)
   357	        (data 4) (data 5) (data 6) (data 7) polynomialX polynomialZ index = 0 := by
   358	  have hpolyX := linePolynomial_natDegree_le_of_coefficients polynomialX hdegreeX
   359	  have hpolyZ := linePolynomial_natDegree_le_of_coefficients polynomialZ hdegreeZ
   360	  have htotal : (combineLinePolynomial (data 0) (data 1) (data 2) (data 3)
   361	      (data 4) (data 5) (data 6) (data 7) polynomialX polynomialZ).natDegree ≤ degree := by
   362	    unfold combineLinePolynomial
   363	    rcases haxis with ⟨halpha, hbeta⟩ | ⟨hparamX, hparamZ⟩
   364	    · simp only [halpha, hbeta, Polynomial.C_0, zero_mul, add_zero]
   365	      refine (Polynomial.natDegree_add_le _ _).trans (max_le ?_ ?_)
   366	      · refine Polynomial.natDegree_mul_le.trans ?_
   367	        simpa only [Polynomial.natDegree_C, Nat.zero_add] using
   368	          (affine_comp_natDegree_le _ (data 0) (data 1) hpolyX)
   369	      · refine Polynomial.natDegree_mul_le.trans ?_
   370	        simpa only [Polynomial.natDegree_C, Nat.zero_add] using
   371	          (affine_comp_natDegree_le _ (data 2) (data 3) hpolyZ)
   372	    · simp only [hparamX, hparamZ, Polynomial.C_0, zero_mul, add_zero, Polynomial.comp_C]
   373	      have hterm (constant slope value : Scalar) :
   374	          ((Polynomial.C constant + Polynomial.C slope * Polynomial.X) *
   375	            Polynomial.C value).natDegree ≤ degree := by

   394	/-- Two equal points on a nonzero affine direction force the parameter slope to vanish. -/
   395	private theorem affine_slope_eq_zero {Scalar : Type*} [Field Scalar] {dimension : ℕ}
   396	    {point base direction : Fin dimension → Scalar} {offset slope : Scalar}
   397	    (hdirection : direction ≠ 0) (hzero : point = base + offset • direction)
   398	    (hone : point = base + (offset + slope) • direction) : slope = 0 := by
   399	  have hequal := add_left_cancel (hzero.symm.trans hone)
   400	  have hvanish : slope • direction = 0 := by
   401	    apply add_left_cancel (a := offset • direction)
   402	    simpa only [add_smul, add_zero] using hequal.symm
   403	  exact (smul_eq_zero.mp hvanish).resolve_right hdirection

   405	/-- Axis subline coordinates satisfy the source's constant-coordinate alternative. -/
   406	theorem SubLineWitness.affineData_axis {params : AdmissibleParams}
   407	    (sublines : SubLineWitness params) (sample : SubLineTriple params)
   408	    (hsample : sample ∈ sublines.D.support) (haxis : sample.1.kind = .axis) :
   409	    let data := sublines.affineData sample hsample
   410	    (data 5 = 0 ∧ data 7 = 0) ∨ (data 1 = 0 ∧ data 3 = 0) := by
   411	  let data := sublines.affineData sample hsample
   412	  have hcompat := sublines.affineData_compatible sample hsample
   413	  have hsource := sublines.axis_closure sample hsample haxis
   414	  have hcoordinate : directPointToPauli params sample.1.direction =
   415	      coordinateDirection sample.1.index := by
   416	    rcases sample with ⟨line, pair⟩
   417	    cases line with
   418	    | axis => exact directPointToPauli_coordinateDirection params _
   419	    | diagonal => cases haxis
   420	  by_cases hspecial : sample.1.index = alphaVar params.m ∨ sample.1.index = betaVar params.m
   421	  · right
   422	    have hprojection : projX (directPointToPauli params sample.1.direction) = 0 ∧
   423	        projZ (directPointToPauli params sample.1.direction) = 0 := by
   424	      rw [hcoordinate]
   425	      rcases hspecial with halpha | hbeta
   426	      · rw [halpha]
   427	        exact ⟨projX_coordinateDirection_alphaVar, projZ_coordinateDirection_alphaVar⟩
   428	      · rw [hbeta]
   429	        exact ⟨projX_coordinateDirection_betaVar, projZ_coordinateDirection_betaVar⟩
   430	    have hzero := hcompat.2.2.2.2 (0 : PauliScalar params)
   431	    have hone := hcompat.2.2.2.2 (1 : PauliScalar params)
   432	    simp only [zero_smul, add_zero, mul_zero] at hzero
   433	    simp only [one_smul, mul_one, projX_add, projZ_add, hprojection.1, hprojection.2,
   434	      add_zero] at hone
   435	    exact ⟨affine_slope_eq_zero (Scalar := PauliScalar params)
   436	      (source_axis_direction_ne_zero _ hsource.1) hzero.1 hone.1,
   437	      affine_slope_eq_zero (Scalar := PauliScalar params)
   438	        (source_axis_direction_ne_zero _ hsource.2) hzero.2 hone.2⟩
   439	  · left
   440	    have halpha := Ne.symm (not_or.mp hspecial).1
   441	    have hbeta := Ne.symm (not_or.mp hspecial).2
   442	    rw [← hcompat.2.1, ← hcompat.2.2.2.1, hcoordinate]
   443	    simp [coordinateDirection, halpha, hbeta]

   455	  intro index hindex

   457	    polynomials.1 polynomials.2 hdegreeX hdegreeZ
   458	    (sublines.affineData_axis sample hsample haxis) index hindex

   463	/-- The conditional average of the actual paired-line POVMs has no outcomes
   464	above degree `d` on an extended axis line, as asserted at paper lines 1127--1132. -/
   465	theorem SubLineWitness.extendedMeasurement_axis_degree {params : AdmissibleParams}
   466	    {error pointError lineError : ℝ} {setting : ProjectiveSetting params error}
   467	    {points : CombinedPointsWitness setting pointError}
   468	    (sublines : SubLineWitness params) (lines : CombinedLinesWitness setting points lineError)
   469	    (side : PlayerSide) (line : DirectLineDesc params.extendedDirectLd)
   470	    (polynomial : DirectDegPoly params.extendedDirectLd (params.m * params.d + 1))
   471	    (haxis : line.kind = .axis) (hdegree : ¬ ∀ index, params.d < index.val → polynomial index = 0) :
   472	    (sublines.extendedMeasurement lines side line).effect polynomial = 0 := by
   473	  classical
   474	  change averageOperatorOverDistribution (sublines.conditionalLaw line) (fun sample =>
   475	    ((lines.T side sample.val.2.1 sample.val.2.2).postprocess
   476	      (sublines.combinedPolynomial sample.val
   477	        (Finset.mem_filter.mp sample.property).1)).effect polynomial) = 0
   478	  unfold averageOperatorOverDistribution
   479	  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
   480	  intro sample _
   481	  have hsample := (Finset.mem_filter.mp sample.property).1
   482	  have hsampleAxis : sample.val.1.kind = .axis := by
   483	    rw [(Finset.mem_filter.mp sample.property).2]
   484	    exact haxis
   485	  have hsource := sublines.axis_closure sample.val hsample hsampleAxis
   486	  suffices hzero : ((lines.T side sample.val.2.1 sample.val.2.2).postprocess
   487	      (sublines.combinedPolynomial sample.val hsample)).effect polynomial = 0 by
   488	    exact (congrArg (fun operator => (sublines.conditionalLaw line).weight sample • operator)
   489	      hzero).trans (smul_zero _)
   490	  rw [Quantum.Measurement.postprocess_effect]
   491	  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
   492	  intro pair hpair
   493	  by_cases hdegreeX : pair.1.FitsDegree params.d
   494	  · by_cases hdegreeZ : pair.2.FitsDegree params.d
   495	    · have hfit := sublines.combinedPolynomial_axis_degree sample.val hsample hsampleAxis
   496	        pair hdegreeX hdegreeZ
   497	      rw [(Finset.mem_filter.mp hpair).2] at hfit
   498	      exact (hdegree hfit).elim
   499	    · exact lines.axis_degree_Z side _ _ _ _ hsource.2 hdegreeZ
   500	  · exact lines.axis_degree_X side _ _ _ _ hsource.1 hdegreeX

   255	        (lines : CombinedLinesWitness setting points lineError) (sublines : SubLineWitness params)

   257	        |avgOver sublines.D (pairedSublineOverlap setting points lines first second) - 1| ≤
   258	          constant * (pointError ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) + Real.sqrt (params.m : ℝ) *
   259	            (lineError ^ (1 / 4 : ℝ) + pointError ^ (1 / 4 : ℝ) +
   260	              error ^ (1 / 4 : ℝ))) := by

   262	  obtain ⟨nearConstant, hnearConstant, hnear⟩ := subline_Z_term_near_one_at

   267	      zPointOverlapAt lines first second (sample.2, projZ (directPointToPauli params

   273	    have heq : Real.sqrt (4 * pointError) = 2 * pointError ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) := by
   274	      rw [Real.sqrt_mul (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 4)]

   280	        (lineError ^ (1 / 4 : ℝ) + pointError ^ (1 / 4 : ℝ)) := by

   282	      first second hopposite

    28	/-- The completed point-pair effect is bounded by the effect of its linear
    29	combination at the actual combined evaluation. Undefined source evaluations
    30	contribute zero on the point side. The statement holds for either player's
    31	measurement without any symmetry assumption on the strategy or local spaces. -/
    32	theorem SubLineWitness.completedPoint_effect_le {params : AdmissibleParams}
    33	    {Carrier : Type*} [Fintype Carrier] [DecidableEq Carrier]
    34	    (sublines : SubLineWitness params) (sample : SubLineTriple params)
    35	    (hsample : sample ∈ sublines.D.support)
    36	    (polynomials : DegPoly params.toLdParams (params.m * params.d) ×
    37	      DegPoly params.toLdParams (params.m * params.d))
    38	    (point : Fin params.extendedDirectLd.m → DirectScalarQ params.extendedDirectLd)
    39	    (hpoint : point ∈ sample.1.pointSet)
    40	    (measurement : Quantum.Measurement (PauliScalar params × PauliScalar params) Carrier) :
    41	    (measurement.postprocess (fun pair => (some pair.1, some pair.2))).effect
    42	      (evalOpt sample.2.1 (projX (directPointToPauli params point)) polynomials.1,
    43	        evalOpt sample.2.2 (projZ (directPointToPauli params point)) polynomials.2) ≤
    44	      (measurement.postprocess (fun pair => some
    45	        ((directPointToPauli params point) (alphaVar params.m) * pair.1 +
    46	          (directPointToPauli params point) (betaVar params.m) * pair.2))).effect
    47	        ((directEvalOpt sample.1 point
    48	          (sublines.combinedPolynomial sample hsample polynomials)).map
    49	            (extendedDirectScalarEquiv params)) := by
    50	  classical
    51	  have hnoneX (value : Option (PauliScalar params)) :
    52	      (measurement.postprocess (fun pair => (some pair.1, some pair.2))).effect (none, value) =
    53	        0 := by
    54	    rw [Quantum.Measurement.postprocess_effect]
    55	    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    56	    intro pair hpair
    57	    have himpossible := congrArg Prod.fst (Finset.mem_filter.mp hpair).2
    58	    simp at himpossible
    59	  have hnoneZ (value : Option (PauliScalar params)) :
    60	      (measurement.postprocess (fun pair => (some pair.1, some pair.2))).effect (value, none) =
    61	        0 := by
    62	    rw [Quantum.Measurement.postprocess_effect]
    63	    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    64	    intro pair hpair
    65	    have himpossible := congrArg Prod.snd (Finset.mem_filter.mp hpair).2
    66	    simp at himpossible
    67	  cases hevalX : evalOpt sample.2.1 (projX (directPointToPauli params point)) polynomials.1 with
    68	  | none =>
    69	    erw [hnoneX]
    70	    exact Quantum.Submeasurement.pos _ _
    71	  | some valueX =>
    72	    cases hevalZ : evalOpt sample.2.2 (projZ (directPointToPauli params point)) polynomials.2 with
    73	    | none =>
    74	      erw [hnoneZ]
    75	      exact Quantum.Submeasurement.pos _ _
    76	    | some valueZ =>
    77	      rw [sublines.combinedPolynomial_evalOpt sample hsample polynomials point hpoint
    78	        valueX valueZ hevalX hevalZ]
    79	      have hinjective : Function.Injective
    80	          (fun pair : PauliScalar params × PauliScalar params => (some pair.1, some pair.2)) := by
    81	        intro left right hequal
    82	        exact Prod.ext (Option.some.inj (congrArg Prod.fst hequal))
    83	          (Option.some.inj (congrArg Prod.snd hequal))
    84	      erw [SandwichProduct.postprocess_effect_of_injective measurement _ hinjective
    85	        (valueX, valueZ)]
    86	      rw [Quantum.Measurement.postprocess_effect]
    87	      exact Finset.single_le_sum (fun pair _ => measurement.pos pair)
    88	        (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, rfl⟩)

   437	          (projZ (point sample))).effect answer) -

   439	            ((setting.pointMeasExp second.side .Z (projZ (point sample))).effect answer.2 *

   448	          (setting.place second ((points.Q second.side coordinates.1 coordinates.2).effect answer) -

   464	            (setting.place first ((lines.T first.side sample.2.1 sample.2.2).effect pair) *

    13	The restriction is the proof-only conditioning used in `lem:qld-xz-lines`,
    14	`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:950-963`.

    23	/-- Probability retained by the proof-only first-line nondegeneracy
    24	restriction in the pasting argument for `lem:qld-xz-lines`. -/
    25	def nondegenerateLinePastingMass (L : LdParams) : ℝ :=
    26	  ∑ samples ∈
    27	      (Distribution.prod (linePointDist L) (linePointDist L)).support.filter
    28	        (fun samples => samples.1.1.direction ≠ 0),
    29	    (Distribution.prod (linePointDist L) (linePointDist L)).weight samples

    36	  let indicator := fun sample : LineDesc L × (Fin L.m → ScalarQ L) =>
    37	    if sample.1.direction ≠ 0 then (1 : ℝ) else 0

+# Issue 512: Recovery of the established extended-line construction
+
+The proof of `exists_extendedLinesWitness_established` was recovered from
+commit `6e8d67ef8ba22de69a0c166adcdf23ba6e7a33aa`, retained at
+`0f4ef05370350f4017439ebd839ef0561f13130f`, onto the isolated issue-512
+worktree based at `ae124f8f09ee002444ac5b9711822c0f1daae142`.
+The preceding receipt is `prover-512-20260912-01.last.md` in the local
+session archive. This is recovery of that proof, not a new mathematical attempt.
+
+This audit is the reader-facing record of that provenance. The Lean module and
+theorem docstrings carry only mathematical source and gap references; the
+commit-level recovery history of each module is kept here instead.
+
+## Scope
+
+The recovered declarations and the modules holding them:
+
+- `MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/Lines/{Sampling,PointComparison,Conditioning,
+  Construction}.lean`
+- `MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/{XEvalDeficit,SubLineXDeficit}.lean`
+- `MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/ExtendedLines/{Measurement,Overlap,Estimates}.lean`
+- the target `exists_extendedLinesWitness_established` in
+  `MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/Apply.lean`
+
+Each of these modules was recovered from the saved commit named above. The
+blueprint counterpart is the formalization-support node
+`lem:qld-4-13-established` in `blueprint/src/chapter/ch15_qpbt_combining.tex`;
+the paired-line consistency theorem it rests on is recorded in
+`lem:combined-line-measurement-consistency` and the supporting nodes beside it.
+
+## Source of Truth
+
+The source is `references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex`,
+`lem:qld-xz-lines` (882-961), `lem:qld-4-10` (689-709), and
+`lem:qld-4-13` with its first proof route (1020-1034, 1118-1246).
+The auxiliary blueprint entry is `lem:qld-4-13-established`. The divergences
+between that entry and the printed lemma are governed by
+`docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_combined-lines-error-term.tex` and
+`docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_ld-dimension-divisibility.tex`.
+
+## Findings
+
+### Construction and provenance
+
+Only declarations needed by the construction were recovered. Existing proofs
+of the combined point witness, subline law, Z deficits, polynomial absorption,
+projection contraction, and heterogeneous pasting were reused. No file from
+another worktree was changed, and the saved branch was neither merged nor copied
+wholesale. The recovered material is divided into modules below 1000 lines.
+
+- `Lines/Sampling`, `PointComparison`, `Conditioning`, and `Construction`
+  recover the needed declarations from saved `Combining/Lines.lean`. The
+  X-Z-X measurement is unchanged. Conditioning is on nonzero X directions;
+  its mass is at least one half, and the discarded contribution is restored
+  with the bound `1/(2q)` under the original product law.
+- The current `combined_line_measurement_consistency` statement is unchanged
+  and moved to `Lines/Construction`. The existing witness constructors now
+  use its proved value. The current heterogeneous pasting theorem needs only
+  the two forward marginal comparisons, so the saved unused second joint
+  family and its extra comparison were omitted. Its error function still
+  satisfies the same polynomial contract.
+- `XEvalDeficit` and `SubLineXDeficit` recover only the opposite-placement
+  X estimates needed from saved `EvalDeficit` and `SubLineDeficit`. The saved
+  XZ ordered-point estimate is added alongside the existing ZX estimate.
+- `ExtendedLines/Measurement`, `Overlap`, and `Estimates` recover the
+  conditional law, affine polynomial construction, degree support, and
+  two-placement real-part overlap estimates from saved `Apply.lean`.
+- The two scalar estimates `rpow_quarter_nonneg` and `sqrt_deficit_bound_le`,
+  which the recovered estimates share with the claims module, are stated in
+  `Combining/ErrorBounds.lean` with the other formalization-only scalar
+  bounds; neither is specific to Claims 17-1 through 17-3.
+- The saved established-error construction is inlined into the target.
+  Its universal outer constant remains `1`. No narrower helper replaces the
+  current `exists_extendedLinesWitness_established_ofPointsWitness`: that
+  obligation quantifies arbitrary scalar point errors, whereas the saved
+  helper first fixes a polynomially controlled point family. Its signature
+  and proof hole are left unchanged.
+
+### Statement integrity
+
+Paper assumptions: an admissible parameter tuple and a projective strategy
+passing the Pauli basis test with error epsilon; the preceding construction
+supplies the joint point measurements.
+
+Lean assumptions: the existing `AdmissibleParams` and `ProjectiveSetting`
+domain. The point witness and its polynomial error are constructed
+existentially. No new bridge premise, positivity premise, axiom, or proof
+hole is added.
+
+Paper conclusion: two extended-line consistency comparisons, axis degree at
+most d, general degree at most md+1, source line-point sampling, field answers,
+and the printed error `poly(m^2 * epsilon, md/q)`.
+
+Lean conclusion: the unchanged directly indexed `ExtendedLinesWitness`, both
+opposite-placement comparisons on completed answers, the same degree bounds,
+and `C * m * poly(epsilon, md/q)` in the corrected additive error convention.
+
+Verdict: exact recovery of the current auxiliary statement. It is not a
+formalization of the printed source theorem: the carrier/law transport,
+completed-answer comparison, and printed-error issues remain recorded in
+`qpbt_ld-dimension-divisibility.tex` and `qpbt_combined-lines-error-term.tex`.
+The complex Claim 17-2 obligation is also unchanged; the recovered proof uses
+separate real-part estimates with their stated line and point errors.
+
+The declaration header is byte-for-byte equal at the base, saved commit,
+and recovered state. Its SHA-256, excluding ` := by`, is
+`fd0305b7aa316707f14f917a4974499ece4c6223a67eec4d3f05fd1445c5a02a`.
+The witness, parameter, carrier, law, and error definitions were not changed.
+
+## Required Action
+
+No follow-up is required for the recovery itself. The obligations it leaves
+open are the pre-existing ones, and they are tracked outside this audit:
+
+- transport of the question carrier and line-point law, in
+  `docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_ld-dimension-divisibility.tex`;
+- conversion of the completed answer comparison to the source summation over
+  `a` in `F_q`, including zero-direction singleton lines, in
+  `docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_combined-lines-error-term.tex`;
+- the printed error form `poly(m^2 * epsilon, md/q)`, whose declaration
+  `exists_extendedLinesWitness` remains unproved;
+- the unchanged proof hole of
+  `exists_extendedLinesWitness_established_ofPointsWitness` and the complex
+  Claim 17-2 obligation.
+
+A reader checking this audit should confirm that the source-labelled entries
+`lem:qld-xz-lines` and `lem:qld-4-13` still carry no formalization mark, and
+that the marks introduced by the recovery sit only on support nodes whose
+statements display their restrictions.
+
+## Validation
+
+Focused Lean checks passed for the recovered modules and the target under
+the worktree's actual Lean v4.32.0 toolchain. A recursive audit traversed
+75,666 type/body dependencies of the target, including 3,310 project
+declarations, checking each axiom closure against the allowed set
+`propext`, `Classical.choice`, `Quot.sound`. The target and the recovered
+line-consistency theorem have exactly that closure, without `sorryAx`.
+The audit program and full output are in the session archive as
+`issue512-recovered-audit.lean` and `issue512-recovered-audit.log`.
+The required locked build and exact-head CI results are recorded by the
+primary `local/bin` workflow and in the session's final receipt.
+
+Historical cost remains thirteen attempts and 26,383 recorded seconds.
+The preceding verification added approximately 805 seconds, giving
+approximately 27,188 seconds before this recovery session. Session
+`prover-512-20260912-02` adds its actual recovery and validation cost to
+that history; its final elapsed time belongs to the dispatcher receipt.
+This recovery does not reset B8 or the historical mathematical-gap budget.
+Independent review remains the next session's responsibility.
